note: One line per century for the pull-back field and under the heading of each century's first decade. Counts are computed live from the merged events, never stored here.

lines.label: 1000s
lines.line: Bi Sheng prints with clay type; Shen Kuo describes the compass.

lines.label: 1100s
lines.line: Fields raised on a Mexican lake; the compass guides ships at sea.

lines.label: 1200s
lines.line: Fibonacci brings Arabic numerals west; al-Jazari draws his machines.

lines.label: 1300s
lines.line: Plague kills up to 50 million; Korea prints Jikji with metal type.

lines.label: 1400s
lines.line: Hangul gives Korean 28 letters; Gutenberg's press, 20 million copies by 1500.

lines.label: 1500s
lines.line: Printing spreads across Europe; Copernicus puts the Sun at the centre.

lines.label: 1600s
lines.line: Galileo turns a telescope skyward; Newton's Principia explains the orbits.

lines.label: 1700s
lines.line: Newcomen's engine pumps a mine in 1712; Watt's condenser in 1769.

lines.label: 1800s
lines.line: Faraday turns motion into current; by 1886 Benz has a car.

lines.label: 1900s
lines.line: Powered flight in 1903; the Web proposed at CERN in 1989.

lines.label: 2000s
lines.line: The iPhone, then ChatGPT; most records here date from 2020 on.
